nom: La Roche-Posay Effaclar Mat Oil Free Face Moisturizer for Oily Skin

avis.texte: **************************PRO TIP**************************** I took the advice of another reviewer and cut off the bottom of the tube to see if I could get any more out, and sure enough, there was a treasure trove of extra moisturizer at the top near the opening that will last you another week at the minimum. When you reach the end of your bottle, definitely cut it open, because this stuff is expensive. I was able to carefully wrap the tube up and store it in a plastic baggie with all the air squeezed out. In total, this tiny bottle lasted from the beginning of August until mid-October for me. ******************************************************** Review: Previously, I've never in my 23 years of life ever been able to have clear skin (other than before puberty). I've always had acne. I always took great care of my face (washed twice a day, avoided touching it), but nothing ever worked. All of the other things on the market (even the supposed #1 dermatologist recommended) never did anything for me; none of the dermatological-prescribed creams, pills, or face washes could ever touch me. I have combination skin: oily/greasy city in some places, and dry as the Sahara in others. If you have it too, you have my sincere condolences, because I think that up to this point in my review, we have had the same experience. Until this brand. Unlike other moisturizers, it's not heavy. It doesn't feel like it's cake. It's light and my skin breathes. It moisturizes the dry spots and doesn't

I've been using La Roche-Posay Effaclar Mat Daily Moisturizer for quite some time now, and it has become my holy grail product for oily skin. This moisturizer has truly transformed the look and feel of my skin in the best possible way. One of the standout features of this moisturizer is its ability to visibly reduce the look of pores. With consistent use, I've noticed a significant improvement in the appearance of my pores, making my skin look smoother and more refined. The oil-free formula is a game-changer for oily skin types like mine. It mattifies the skin without feeling heavy or greasy, providing the perfect balance of hydration and mattifying properties. I also appreciate that this moisturizer smooths skin texture, leaving my complexion looking more even and radiant. The non-comedogenic formula is gentle and doesn't clog pores, which is crucial for preventing breakouts. As someone with sensitive skin, I'm pleased that this moisturizer is dermatologist tested and hasn't caused any irritation or sensitivity issues. Overall, I highly recommend La Roche-Posay Effaclar Mat Daily Moisturizer to anyone with oily or combination skin looking for a lightweight, mattifying, and pore-reducing moisturizer. It's a must-have in my skincare routine and has delivered exceptional results. ---

avis.titre: Fantastic Moisture for Oily Skin.  Controls Oil for Hours.
avis.texte: Even in middle-age, my skin is still as oily as a teenager's. While that may be great for keeping the wrinkles at bay, no one likes the shiny-faced look and the problems that go with it in putting on makeup. After using a few other La Roche-Posay facial products, I gave this one a try and it's fabulous! It looks a little "frosted" coming out of the tube...a little matte...not shiny like other moisturizers. It goes on smoothly, is lightweight, and give a matte finish to your face IMMEDIATELY. Does a good job of making your skin feel soft and smooth with no shine involved. If you wanted to go out without makeup, you could very easily, and now I often do. I simply couldn't do that before. I always felt that I had to put on some powder to take away the shine from a moisturizer...but now there IS no shine to have to cover up. Amazing. When I do apply makeup, there's no residue or oil that gets added to the mix. Foundations go on beautifully without reacting with greasy moisturizer. And like the other products in this line, it has been wonderful on my very sensitive and allergic skin...no breakouts and overall redness seems to be reduced. I just love this stuff. One day, my teen daughter asked to use some. She loves it and is now lobbying for her own supply. I wish this had been around when I was a teen! Highly recommend. Pricey, but a little goes a long way, and you may save on all the makeup. :)

I LOVE this moisturizer! I'm surprised I haven't reviewed it before! I've been using this product for years now and I'll never stop as long as they make it! This moisturizer is great for combination or oily skin. I use it every day after showering and washing my face. I have bad combination skin. My skin is extremely irritable. I break out and get rashes from almost everything, but not this! I have persistent adult acne and rashes. My skin also gets very dry and cracked, especially in the winter. Before using this product I'd get painful and embarrassing cracking and redness around my nose and mouth every winter and I haven't had it since! My skin can get painfully dry on top of having acne. If you frequently have to wash your face, or any skin, because of acne or irritation that can dry out your skin and your body can try to overcompensate for that dryness and produce more oil than needed, microscopic cracks can form in the skin and get irritated by this oil or dirt and clog pores and guess what? You're back where you started. This ends the cycle of combination skin! My face looks and feels smoother after every use! It visibly reduces pores and redness without making skin only. It's soothing and very effective. I'd recommend this product for everyone, not just those with sensitive or problem skin. It feels light on the skin and leaves you feeling fresh and perfectly moisturized all day. The matte finish won't over dry skin but also prevents break outs, and feels like you hav

So far so good! Since coming off of hormonal birth control, my skin has been so unbelievably oily; it has always been oily but definitely not like now where I wake up as if I washed my face in oil. I have only used this once so far, but I am very pleased with it. My skin has been picky but loves La Roche-Posay, so after trying other oil-control moisturizers with little improvement, I decided to try this one. I love how it feels, it doesn't dry down into a sticky or greasy feeling and provides enough hydration for my dehydrated but oily skin. It has a very pleasant almost berry-esque fragarance and leaves my skin looking matte after application--which I find super rare in other oil-control moisturizers. I absolutely just love how it feels hydrating, non-sticky, non-greasy, and hopefully will provide more oil-control. I love it so far! It is quite small, so I will likely only be using it on my T-Zone, which is fine as that's where I become the most oily.

avis.titre: I don’t even need oil blotters anymore!!!!
avis.texte: I have always struggled to find something for my oily skin and large pores but just accepted my skin the way it is until I started having extreme amounts of oil and breakouts in my t zone. I was literally getting about 20+ tiny little pimples around my nose area from all the excess oil. I decided to start looking into new products and came across this along with the Effaclar medicated gel cleanser 2%! Omg it’s amazing!!! My face has cleared up, it’s moisturized and looks amazing! I have never seen my skin look so smooth and soft in my 30+ years of wearing makeup. I absolutely love this line of product!

Super effective for my summer oily skin. But pretty expensive compared to what I would normally purchase. It is smaller than their typical moisturizer so be aware. I did read the reviews about it but didn’t realize exactly how small until I received the product. I did use every last drop!!
This work very well for me , I have oily skin especially when the weather is hot, it stops my skin from looking oily.

avis.titre: Non-comedogenic, quality sebum-regulating and moisturizing product!!
avis.texte: I was very tempted to try the Effaclar line from La Roche-Posay, and I do not regret it. I tend to avoid overusing sebum-regulating products because they often cause your skin to produce more oil as a response, but this one is different. I only incorporate sebum-regulating products into my AM skincare routine. This product leaves your skin feeling hydrated and fresh without clogging pores, so there’s no breakout after starting to use it. It's also very suitable for my sensitive, oily skin.

I am a skincare fanatic and this is absolutely my #1 go-to moisturizer before putting on any makeup. If I don’t wear makeup that day and just do my skincare before leaving, this is ALWAYS the moisturizer I put on. I have combo skin so I tend to get oily in my t-zone and I searched high and low for a moisturizer I could put on before I did my makeup / left the house for the day. After trying so many different ones, this is the one I fell in love with. I am super picky when it comes to skincare. I am a beauty content creator and I receive a LOT of PR packages from different brands so I have tried a ton of different products. I can’t see myself finding a better day time moisturizer than this one. I’m very particular with my day time skincare because with combo skin I don’t want to look all shiny unlike my nighttime skincare routine. This moisturizer isn’t too heavy but is still super hydrating. It is so mattifying and pore blurring which I love. When I use this alongside my pore blurring primers, my face looks and feels so good. I am really finicky about feeling clean / not feeling sticky and gross (which some products can feel that way) and this has truly saved my face. Like I said, I don’t think I’ll ever find a day time moisturizer I love as much as this one. If you have combo/oily skin, I 10/10 recommend! Of course I use different/heavier moisturizers at night but this will forever be in my top 3 of day time skincare products.

avis.titre: It has been a good experience for my oily skin with open pores
avis.texte: It doesn't feel heavy and integrates well into your skincare routine without interfering with other products. I haven't noticed any breakouts or adverse reactions, which is a big plus. While it promises to reduce the appearance of pores, I haven't noticed a huge change in this regard. It's not the most hydrating, so it can leave some areas a bit dry.

avis.titre: Great for large pores and combined skin (oily/dry)!!!
avis.texte: Absolutely wonderful moisturizer! I have large pores in my T zone and around the nose, always struggling with sebum (oil) in that zone and have super dry skin on my cheeks, so, I was looking for the cream which can regulate the sebum and moisturize the cheeks skin. And I found one! Finally, after trying dozens of different creams - this is the PERFECT one for me!!! My pores reduced in size after just a few days of usage. Finally! I was struggling with it so much! The general color of my face changed, got rid of dark circles, brown-ish shade on the face, as you can see on pics - my skin looks much healthier and fresh. All the picS were taken wearing zero make up for my own track. Omg, it’s just like a magic emulsion for my skin. Definitely recommend to try if you have the same problems as I do.

I have extremely oily skin. I bought this product along with the Efffaclar gel cleanser in hopes they would help. Sadly I was disappointed. The "mat" finish existed for about 45 minutes, then I was back to oily. Both the cleanser and moisturizer are extremely fragrant which I don't care for. I gave it a month, but I noticed no change in my skin at all and it was too late to return it for a refund. Previously I purchased the Toleriane cleanser and moisturizer for oily skin....that line disappointed as well. I guess LaRoche Posay just isn't for me.

5/5 ALL THE WAY! I have acne-prone VERY oily skin! When i first applied this. It wasn't sticky at all and takes about 1-2 min to completely absorb into my skin! But once it dries down. It is MATTE! Believe me when i say this is GREAT. I have tried over 10 different moisturizer from drugstore to 60 dollars ones and all seems to be too sticky or leave my skin very oily! This is a miracle! Although i wish i would get more products because I can imagine I'd be running out of this in just 1 month. If you have oily skin and is acne prone. This is going a MIRACLE WORKER for you. This is my 1st week of using this moisturizer and it has not broken me out yet which is another plus! TOTALLY RECOMMEND to any of my oily skin gals out there!

I started using La-Roche Posay after a dermatologist recommended their Double Moisture Repair (https://a.co/d/arjhxLV). I liked its softness, texture, and weight better than other brands like Drunk Elephant, Clinique, and CeraVe. So why the switch to Effaclar Mat? I guess marketing worked its magic on me? I seem to have thought that having oily-combination skin warranted destabilizing my skin routine on a whim to try something ~new~. What I found was that this just isn’t doing it for me. At 31 years old, I am too young to be paying almost $40 for a travel-sized moisturizer. “Matified” is more reminiscent of sunscreen texture-wise than the Double Moisture Repair. The scent isn’t crazy but it also isn’t my favorite. I’ll be introducing something else for my pores into my routine, because this isn’t giving me what I hoped for.
